title: Integral localization commutes with bounded qcqs pushforward
statement: For the coefficient inclusion of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients], any qcqs map f:X→Y of schemes, and any bounded constructible integral complex K on X, the specified component derivedPushHom(a,f).app K is an isomorphism. Pushforward is ordinary and uncompleted, and no proper base change assertion is assumed.

proof.text: The lower derived pushforward preserves bounded-below objects: apply the existing lower-degree homology vanishing theorem for its bounded-below derived functor and transport through rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility. Both the localization cocone of Rf_*K and the image under Rf_* of the localization cocone of K become colimit cocones on every cohomology sheaf, by the localization homology theorem and qcqs localization continuity respectively.

Compose restriction of the specified scalar-extension/pushforward mate with the restriction-pushforward comparison. The adjunction mate identity verifies its zeroth localization leg. Multiplication by ℓ is invertible at its target. The localization cocone comparison theorem makes every cohomology of this composite invertible. Scalar invertibility reuses the existing module_nsmul_isIso or derived_nsmul_isIso theorem from ContinuousConstructibleIntegralImage, made public without changing its type or proof.

Derived cohomology detects isomorphisms. Cancel the restriction-pushforward comparison isomorphism. Restriction reflects isomorphisms: module restriction has the same underlying morphism, and the derived homology factorization reduces derived reflection to module reflection. Thus the specified mate itself is invertible.

proof_origin.note: B2 second reading: expose the existing module_nsmul_isIso and derived_nsmul_isIso without changing their types or proofs; reuse existing tensor-unit helpers through import all. No target or existing mathematical statement is changed; all new auxiliary proofs are complete.

    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (K : integralConstructible ℓ E X) :
